'''Nardah''' is a town in the far south of the [[Kharidian Desert]]. In the quest [[Spirits of the Elid]], players work to save the town from drought. After the quest, the town is popular for [[Ironmen]] training [[Herblore]], and players recharging their stats at its [[Elidinis Statuette|statue]]. The bank is unofficially regarded as the Herblore Guild.

==Transportation==
Several transport options bring players into or close to Nardah, listed here with their arrival destination. From closest to farthest:
*{{Plink|Nardah teleport}} — town centre.
*{{Plink|Desert amulet 2|txt=Desert amulets}} — Temple of Elidinis. Amulets 2 and 3 offer one teleport daily; amulet 4 offers unlimited teleports.
*{{Plink|Fairy ring|pic=Fairy ring (Construction) icon}} {{Fairycode|dlq}} — north of Nardah, near the [[desert lizard]]s.
*{{Plink|Pharaoh's sceptre}} — [[Jaleustrophos]] ([[Simon Templeton]]'s camp).
*{{Plink|Construct. cape|txt=Construction cape}} — [[Pollnivneach]] house portal.
The [[magic carpet]] system can be also used to travel to Nardah from south [[Pollnivneach]].

== History ==
{{LoreSources|ballad|Ghaslor the Elder|Spirits of the Elid|dialogue2=yes}}

The town of Nardah was founded by [[Nardarine]], a refugee whose hometown was destroyed in the [[God Wars]]. Originally hailing from a town loyal to [[Saradomin]], she prayed to her god while dying of thirst, but her calls went unanswered. Instead, the desert goddess [[Elidinis]] appeared, and offered her food and water in exchange for her fealty. She also gave them a holy statuette.

The town flourished, drawing water from the nearby [[River Elid]]. Some time later, however, a Saradominist priest visited the town, and pushed the people to swear loyalty to Saradomin instead. He was very convincing, and instructed the townspeople to throw the statuette away.

Before long, the river dried up, and Elidinis did not respond to the prayers of the townspeople. One citizen, Jareesh, travelled to a dungeon at the mouth of the river, in hopes of finding Elidinis directly. However, he was unable to pass the dungeon's challenges, and his story was memorialised in a ballad.

In the year 169, an [[Player character|adventurer]] came to the town, and used the information from the ballad to traverse the dungeon and uncover the cause of the curse, learning of the affront caused by throwing away the statuette. The adventurer successfully retrieved the statuette from a malevolent [[Genie (Spirits of the Elid)|genie]] nearby, returning it to the town and breaking the curse.

=== Skilling locations ===
There are two [[clay oven]]s in the town, one on the north side and one near the bank. There is also an [[anvil]] in the armour store.

===Other===

* [[Rok's Chocs Box]] — a stall in the town centre which 25 [[chocolate bar]]s for {{Coins|10}} each and 30 [[choc-ice]] for {{Coins|30}} each.
* [[Waterskin]]s can be refilled by or bought from Ali the Carter in the town centre for {{Coins|1000}} each. After the quest, the fountain next to him functions as a [[water source]].
* Ali's Flying Carpet — a flying carpet that offers transport to [[Pollnivneach]].
* Genie's crevice, a pit featuring snakes and the genie. 
* Dock — a currently unused dock, likely featuring in future [[Sailing]] updates.

==Inhabitants==

=== Personalities ===
*{{Chatl|Ali the Carter}}, a conman who takes advantage of the town's drought for a profit.
*{{Chatl|Artimeus}}, an expert hunter who runs the town [[Hunter]] shop.
*{{Chatl|Awusah the Mayor}}, a clueless mayor who somehow still has public support.
*{{Chatl|Burntof}}, a dwarf who likes explosives (after [[Below Ice Mountain]]).
*{{Chatl|Checkal}}, a strongman who helps with [[Willow (Below Ice Mountain)|Willow]]'s schemes (after [[Below Ice Mountain]]).
*{{Chatl|Garai}}, a citizen of the town who shares his thoughts on the drought.
*{{Chatl|Genie (Spirits of the Elid)|text=Genie}}, the evil brother of the [[Genie|genie who gives players lamps]].
*{{Chatl|Ghaslor the Elder}}, the town Elder.
*{{Chatl|Habibah}}, a citizen of the town.
*{{Chatl|Kazemde}}, the general store owner.
*{{Chatl|Marley}}, a robber down on his luck (after [[Below Ice Mountain]]).
*{{Chatl|Meskhenet}}, a citizen of the town.
*{{Chatl|Monkey (magic carpet)|text=Monkey}}, a cute animal who accompanies the [[rug merchant]].
*4 {{Chatl|Nardah Banker|text=Nardah bankers}}, who help players access the [[bank of Gielinor]].
*{{Chatl|Nkuku}}, a citizen of the town.
*{{Chatl|Rokuh}}, a merchant who sells several chocolate items.
*{{Chatl|Rug Merchant|pic=Rug Merchant (2) chathead|text=Rug merchant}}, who can transport player to [[Pollnivneach]].
*{{Chatl|Seddu}}, the town armour merchant.
*{{Chatl|Shiratti the Custodian}}, the curator of the Temple of Elidinis.
*{{Chatl|Usi}}, a citizen of the town.
*{{Chatl|Wesley}}, a man with a penchant for crushing stuff.
*{{Chatl|Willow (Below Ice Mountain)|text=Willow}}, a grave-robber pretending to be an archaeologist (after [[Below Ice Mountain]]).
*{{Chatl|Zahra}}, a citizen of the town.
*{{Chatl|Zahur}}, a herbalist who can clean herbs and decant potions.
